name: gitlab-issue-comment
script:
set -e
repo="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_OWNER/$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_NAME"
id=${PECORE_PARAMS_TICKET:-$PECORE_TICKET_ID}
if [ -z "$id" ]; then exit 0; fi
case "$id" in "https://$GITLAB_HOST/$repo/-/issues/"*) id=${id##*/} ;; esac
case "$id" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "Enter a ticket ID or link for this repository." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
input=$(cat)
body=${PECORE_PARAMS_COMMENT:-}
if [ -z "$body" ]; then
  body=$(printf '%s\n' "$input" | jq -er '.reference.url // .text | strings | select(length > 0)')
fi
is_delivery=$(printf '%s\n' "$input" | jq -r '.reference.url != null')
if [ -n "$PECORE_PARAMS_COMMENT" ]; then is_delivery=false; fi
case "$0" in
*-probe)
  [ "$is_delivery" = true ] || exit 0
  encoded=$(jq -nr --arg repo "$repo" '$repo | @uri')
  notes=$(glab api --paginate "projects/$encoded/issues/$id/notes")
  printf '%s\n' "$notes" | jq -rs --arg body "$body" 'select(any(.[][]; (.body | contains($body)))) | $body'
  ;;
*) glab issue note "$id" -R "$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_URL" --message "$body" ;;
esac
